worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.summar: A bug-armour cannonball thrown the instant the user is sent out: extremely fast and the heaviest hit in the set, hammering the target back on contact. Once the user has acted, it cannot lunge again until it counts as fresh once more.
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.use.0: Land the heaviest lunge right after entering battle
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.use.1: Cripple a foe as the fight opens
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.use.2: Hammer a foe into a corner before it reacts
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.descri: The full-body lunge deals about %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
It lunges up to %1$s blocks along the aim at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block radius; it stops at the first enemy it touches, and on a hit shoves it back up to %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.reckle: Reckless form: heavier, farther and with a harder shove, but a slower wind-up, longer recovery and cooldown, and harder to get back up.
Steady form: base power with a clean landing that stands back up quickly.
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s. Usable only when more than about 30 seconds have passed since the user's last action - usually right after entering battle, before it has acted.
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.growth: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s.
From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s and the leap to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.prefer: On: heavier (x1.12), farther (x1.08) and with a harder shove (x1.25), but a 3-tick slower wind-up, 4 more recovery and 8 more cooldown, and harder to get back up. Off: a clean landing that stands back up quickly.
Only lunge in at a foe within this distance. The leap is medium, so larger values commit earlier; smaller values keep it to point-blank openings.
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.descri: A lunge that comes up empty (blocked by terrain or reaching full distance without touching a foe) deals no damage; and any use, hit or miss, spends the opening.
